description: This file provides helper exports for the Lobster plugin, including plugin entry definitions and Windows spawn policy functions, as well as type imports used in the plugin SDK.

methods.name: definePluginEntry
methods.description: Exports the plugin entry point function for the Yarn plugin system.

methods.name: applyWindowsSpawnProgramPolicy
methods.description: Function to apply Windows spawn program policies.

methods.name: materializeWindowsSpawnProgram
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a Windows spawn program based on policies.

methods.name: resolveWindowsSpawnProgramCandidate
methods.description: Resolves the candidate program for Windows spawn.
